risk_flags.description: The proposed test would not actually prove year filtering works, because the stated fixture contains no out-of-year expense to exclude. It could pass even if `--year` ignored the year entirely.

Leaving the combined `--year` and `--month` case undefined is risky because the parser will accept both options unless the work explicitly prevents it. The contract should define whether this is an error or a combined filter before implementation starts.
risk_flags.span: No defined behavior when both `--year` and `--month` are passed simultaneously (the request does not specify this case)

verdict.primary_risk: The test plan does not prove the requested behavior because its sample data is entirely within the requested year.
